CMOS sampled voltage-to-time converter
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
II 0 iref 20u
VB vb 0 .9
VR vref 0 .8
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 1.2 150n 1.2 160n 1.6 350n 1.6 360n 2.0 600n 2.0)
VS sample 0 PULSE(3.3 0 20n 100p 100p 159.9n 200n)
VRUN run 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 100p 100p 159.9n 200n)
XDUT vdd 0 vin ramp iref run sample vref vb out astra_063_cmos_voltage_to_time_converter
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec t1 range 1.5e-8 3e-8 unit=s
* @spec t2 range 3e-8 5e-8 unit=s
* @spec t3 range 5e-8 7.5e-8 unit=s
* @spec sample1 range 1.18 1.22 unit=V
* @spec sample2 range 1.58 1.62 unit=V
* @spec sample3 range 1.98 2.02 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 600n
meas tran t1 TRIG v(run) VAL=1.65 RISE=1 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 FALL=1
meas tran t2 TRIG v(run) VAL=1.65 RISE=2 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 FALL=2
meas tran t3 TRIG v(run) VAL=1.65 RISE=3 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 FALL=3
meas tran sample1 FIND v(ramp) AT=15n
meas tran sample2 FIND v(ramp) AT=215n
meas tran sample3 FIND v(ramp) AT=415n
write out.raw v(out) v(ramp) v(vin) v(run) v(sample)
quit
.endc
.end
